title: VLM-GUARD: Safeguarding Vision-Language Models via Fulfilling Safety Alignment Gap
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment for Vision-Language Models to prevent responses to malicious instructions and jailbreak attacks. While its evaluation metrics use a safety policy that mentions religion and societal values as categories to filter out harmful content, the research does not specifically investigate, evaluate, or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or ethical/moral reasoning frameworks as a primary focus.
